> **Note:** This package currently only provides metadata for the most recent monthly reporting period. Older monthly periods might have less, or different measures.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(nhstt)
library(dplyr)
library(reactable)

# Metadata for monthly EA measures
metadata_monthly_ea <- get_metadata_monthly() |>
  filter(measure_type == "EA") |>
  select(measure_id, description)
```

In total there are **`r length(unique(metadata_monthly_ea$measure_id))`** monthly Employment Advisor (EA) measures:

```{r}
#| label: tab-measures-monthly-ea
#| echo: false

reactable(
  metadata_monthly_ea,
  searchable = TRUE,
  sortable = FALSE,
  defaultPageSize = 10,
  columns = list(
    measure_id = colDef(
      name = "Measure ID and description",
      cell = function(value, index) {
        description <- metadata_monthly_ea$description[index]
        htmltools::tags$div(
          htmltools::tags$code(
            style = "color: #2A788EFF;",
            value
          ),
          ": ",
          description
        )
      }
    ),
    description = colDef(show = FALSE, searchable = TRUE)
  ),
  outlined = TRUE,
  striped = TRUE
)
```
